comparison_note: s01 polyphone, s08 sandhi, s10 erhua, s11 date plus time plus decimal. Every model reads exactly these four sentences for the listening comparison.
note: Generic test sentences written for this test only. They are NOT Nicholas's private study notes. The same comparison_set is read by every model so clips can be compared directly.

reference_voice.description: CosyVoice and IndexTTS are zero-shot cloners, so they need a short reference clip. Both use the same one: asset/zero_shot_prompt.wav from the Apache-2.0 CosyVoice repo, a Mandarin female speaker, transcript 希望你以后能够做的比我还好呦. Qwen3-TTS uses its built-in preset speaker Vivian instead, since CustomVoice needs no reference clip.
reference_voice.prompt_text: You are a helpful assistant.<|endofprompt|>希望你以后能够做的比我还好呦。
reference_voice.prompt_wav: asset/zero_shot_prompt.wav from FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice (cloned inside the Modal image, not stored in this repo)

sentences.category: tone sandhi 不, 一, third tone
sentences.focus: 不 bu4 before 想 xiang3, 不 bu2 before 去 qu4, 一 yi2 before 下 xia4, 好好 hao3 hao3 third-tone pair, 你也 ni3 ye3.
sentences.text: 我不想去，你也不想去，我们都想好好休息一下。

sentences.focus: 你好 ni2 hao3, 我也 wo3 ye3, 雨水 yu3 shui3, 买水果 mai3 shui3 guo3. Listen for whether the first third tone rises.
sentences.text: 你好，我也很好，雨水很少，我们一起去买水果。

sentences.focus: 院儿, 玩儿, 花儿, 鸟儿. Listen for the rolled r ending, not a separate er syllable.
sentences.text: 下午我们去小院儿里坐坐，那儿很好玩儿，还有花儿和鸟儿。

sentences.focus: Digits written as digits on purpose, to test text normalisation: 2026年11月15日, 3点半, 12.5元.
sentences.text: 会议定在2026年11月15日下午3点半，费用是12.5元，请提前十分钟到。

sentences.focus: 12.5 read as 十二点五, not one-two-point-five. 四块五 as money.
sentences.text: 费用是12.5元，一共三杯咖啡，每杯四块五。

sentences.focus: Long digit strings: are they read digit by digit, or garbled as a big number?
sentences.text: 订单号是202611150123，电话后四位是7522，请核对一下。

sentences.focus: 北京大学, 天安门广场. Plain proper names, a control sentence.
sentences.text: 小明和小红去北京大学听讲座，回来的时候路过天安门广场。
